keeper.name: impeccable
keeper.purpose: Flagship multi-command design skill for AI coding agents: 1 skill with 23 sub-commands (shape, critique, audit, polish, bolder, quieter, distill, harden, onboard, animate, colorize, typeset, layout, delight, overdrive, clarify, adapt, optimize, live, init, document, extract), a 59-rule deterministic anti-pattern detector wired in as a PostToolUse/Stop hook, live in-browser variant iteration, and per-project design context (PRODUCT.md / DESIGN.md / surface briefs). Apache-2.0, 62,896 stars, actively maintained (pushed 2026-08-26, v4.1.2).
keeper.reason: Not vendorable through this pipeline despite a clean Apache-2.0 license and top-tier quality. (1) The skill directory is 3.4 MB / 153 files and contains build artifacts that cannot be reviewed line-by-line: scripts/detector/detect-antipatterns-browser.js (390 KB, header says 'GENERATED -- do not edit. Source: cli/engine/browser/injected/index.mjs'), scripts/modern-screenshot.umd.js (minified third-party UMD bundle), scripts/live-browser.js (500 KB injected browser script), plus ~1.5 MB of further scripts (hook-lib.mjs 100 KB, serve-question.mjs 120 KB, detector/rules/checks.mjs 254 KB) - an automatic disqualifier under the rubric's reviewability rule. (2) The skill is one part of a version-locked system: install/update is owned by the npx impeccable CLI, hook wiring lives outside the skill dir (.claude/settings.json PostToolUse/Stop hooks, .claude/agents/ subagents), and built-in staleness/doctor machinery (scripts/lib/staleness*.mjs, reference/doctor.md) compares installed artifacts against the current version, so a static vendored snapshot would immediately degrade and report itself stale. (3) Scripts legitimately reach the network (localhost live servers, Google Fonts and impeccable.style assets in served decision pages, and generate-image.mjs reads OPENAI_API_KEY and calls api.openai.com) - declared features, but policy-relevant. Users should install from upstream: npx impeccable install, or the Claude Code plugin marketplace (pbakaus/impeccable).

securityNotes: Reviewed at pinned SHA 63b04e2530f5c7b41ea83c133daab24f34912456 from the codeload tarball. No hidden instructions or prompt-injection found: grep of SKILL.md, all reference/*.md and agents/*.md for ignore-user-rules / exfiltration / secrecy patterns came back clean. Scripts: grepped all *.mjs for network and exec use. Non-localhost network: generate-image.mjs POSTs to api.openai.com/v1/images/* using process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY (declared image-generation feature with an explicit no-key error path); serve-question.mjs serves a localhost page that links fonts.googleapis.com and inspiration images on impeccable.style; everything else is localhost live-server/browser-injection plumbing. 15 scripts use child_process/spawn (opening browsers, node subprocesses). No download-and-execute of remote code found in the authored sources. Blocking issue is reviewability, not malice: detect-antipatterns-browser.js is a generated 390 KB bundle ('do not edit'), modern-screenshot.umd.js is minified vendor code, live-browser.js is 500 KB - not line-by-line reviewable, so the skill fails the pipeline's script-review requirement.
overlaps: design-auditor (quarantined, this pipeline): overlaps impeccable's audit/critique commands
structureNotes: Repo anatomy verified at the pinned SHA: skill/ is the build SOURCE (SKILL.src.md + reference/ + scripts/, no detector/); the installable skill is the compiled per-provider tree, for Claude Code .claude/skills/impeccable/ (SKILL.md v4.1.2, name: impeccable, frontmatter uses non-spec fields version/user-invocable/argument-hint alongside allowed-tools) plus .claude/agents/*.md subagents and .claude/settings.json hooks. The npm package ships only cli/ + LICENSE (package.json files field): cli/bin/cli.js is the installer/updater and the standalone 'npx impeccable detect' detector CLI; the detector engine lives in cli/engine/ and is copied into the built skill under scripts/detector/ (skill/scripts/detect.mjs is a 620-byte shim). 20 provider trees (.claude, .cursor, .codex/.agents, .gemini, .github, .grok, etc.) are committed builds of the same single skill.

#### pbakaus/impeccable (inspected 2026-08-26)
- HEAD of main pinned: 63b04e2530f5c7b41ea83c133daab24f34912456 (committed 2026-08-26T06:02:54Z; repo pushed 2026-08-26T06:04:37Z). Stars verified via API: 62,896. License: Apache-2.0 - full text read at repo-root LICENSE at pinned SHA; package.json license field and SKILL.md frontmatter agree. NOTICE.md: reference/ios.md and reference/android.md distilled from ehmo/platform-design-skills (MIT).
- Tree: 3,270 blobs (recursive tree API, not truncated; blob SHAs recorded in scratchpad). One skill, materialized into 20 provider directories; canonical Claude Code install is .claude/skills/impeccable/ (153 files, 3.4 MB).
- Files read: README.md, package.json, LICENSE, NOTICE.md, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .claude/settings.json, skills-lock.json, SKILL.md (full), reference/craft-floor.md, reference/audit.md (sampled), scripts/lib/provider.mjs, heads of live-browser.js / detect-antipatterns-browser.js / modern-screenshot.umd.js, generate-image.mjs (key paths), hook-lib.mjs (URL lines); grep sweep of all scripts for network/exec/credentials and all markdown for injection patterns.
- Rubric: relevance 3 (core design workflow), quality 3 (concrete criteria, calibrated bans, bounded verification passes), conformance 1 (valid SKILL.md but non-spec frontmatter fields, hook/agent wiring outside the skill dir, installer- and version-coupled), uniqueness 2. Total 9.
- Verdict: not-vendored-keeper. Clean license and excellent quality, but automatic disqualifier on reviewability (generated 390 KB browser-detector bundle marked 'do not edit', minified UMD vendor file, 500 KB browser script) plus install/update and staleness machinery that makes a static vendored copy self-degrading. Point users to npx impeccable install / plugin marketplace instead.
- compatibility note: frontmatter uses fields outside the spec six (version, user-invocable, argument-hint) - claude-ai must NOT be listed if this is ever reconsidered.
